title: Placement Portal App
description: A full-stack web app where an institute, companies and students manage campus recruitment in one place. It replaces spreadsheets and emails with role-based dashboards for job posting, applications and placement tracking.

title: Vehicle Parking App
description: A web-based multi-user vehicle parking management system. Users can register, log in and book a parking spot by entering their vehicle number, and the fee is calculated from the parking duration. Admins can monitor users, parking slots and revenue using visual graphs.

title: Smart MCQ Solver Challenge
description: A Kaggle competition, the Smart MCQ Solver Challenge: each question has 5 options (A-E) with one correct answer. For each question, predict the top 3 most likely options. Scoring uses MAP@3, which gives full credit if the correct answer is ranked first, partial credit (1/2) if second, and so on.

title: Comment Category Prediction
description: Predicts the final category assigned to online user comments in a Kaggle classification challenge. Compares Logistic Regression, LightGBM, Random Forest and Linear SVC, with hyperparameter tuning using GridSearchCV, RandomizedSearchCV and HalvingGridSearchCV.
